# semaphore_ex_workflow_trigger_test (Action)

Fires a real workflow trigger and creates an invocation/run. This is an operational test, not a dry-run preview. Executes only through explicit Action invocation. Progress reports a bounded, non-secret summary.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_workflow_trigger_test" "example" {
  config {
    project_id  = 1
    workflow_id = 2
    trigger_id  = 3
    inputs      = { release = "example" }
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_workflow_trigger_test.example
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number)
- `trigger_id` (Number)
- `workflow_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `inputs` (Dynamic) Optional native object of declared trigger inputs.
